questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution of India defines the power of the President to grant pardons, etc, and to suspend, remit or commute sentences in certain cases?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 72.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Constitutional Provision to Grant Pardon: Article 72
 
• Article 72 of the Constitution empowers the President to grant pardons to persons who have been tried and convicted of any offence in all cases where the:
 
 
• Punishment or sentence for an offence against a Union Law.
 
• Punishment or sentence is by a court-martial (military court).
 
• Punishment is a Death sentence.​
 
 
 
• Pardoning Power of President
 
• Article 72 empowers the President the power to grant pardons, reprieves, respites or remissions of punishment or to suspend, remit or commute the sentence of any person convicted of any offence.
 
• The meaning of these terms is as follows:
 
 
• Pardon: It removes both the sentence and the conviction and completely absolves the convict from all sentences, punishments, and disqualifications.
 
• Commutation: It denotes the substitution of one form of punishment with a lighter form of punishment. For example, a death sentence may be commuted to rigorous imprisonment.
 
• Remission: It implies reducing the period of the sentence without changing its character. For example, a sentence of rigorous imprisonment for five years may be remitted to rigorous imprisonment for one year.
 
• Respite: It denotes awarding a lesser sentence in place of one originally awarded due to some special fact, such as the physical disability of a convict or the pregnancy of a woman offender.
 
• Reprieve: It implies a stay of the execution of a sentence (especially that of death) for a temporary period. Its purpose is to enable the convict to have time to seek pardon or commutation from the President.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information​__**

questions.question: Energy and carbon requirements of the autotrophic organism are fulfilled by____.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Photosynthesis__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Autotroph

__
 
• **Autotrophic organisms prepare their own food.**
 
• The chloroplast helps in preparing food.
 
• They obtain energy from inorganic sources by converting light energy into chemical energy.
 
• The carbon and energy requirements of autotrophic organisms are fulfilled by photosynthesis.
 
• It is a process in which autotrophic organisms utilize carbon dioxide and water in the presence of sunlight and chlorophyll to form carbohydrates, the energy source.
 
• They are placed at the primary level in the food chain.
 
• Green plants, algae and a few photosynthetic bacteria are examples of autotrophs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The term glycolysis has originated from the Greek words, glycos for ''sugar'' and lysis for ''splitting''.
 
• The scheme of glycolysis was given by Gustav Embden, Otto Meyerhof, and J. Parnas, and is often referred to as the EMP pathway.
 
• In anaerobic organisms, it is the only process in respiration.
 
• Glycolysis occurs in the cytoplasm of the cell and is present in all living organisms.
 
• In this process, glucose undergoes partial oxidation to form two molecules of pyruvic acid.

questions.question: In 1818, the Holkar Dynasty signed the Treaty of Mandsaur with the_____.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**British**__.

__
 
• **In 1818, the Holkar Dynasty signed the Treaty of Mandsaur with the British.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Treaty of Mandsaur -

 
 
• The **Treaty of Mandsaur** was signed between Sir Thomas Hislop and Malhar Rao Holkar II on 6th January 1818.
 
• It was signed after the Battle of Mahidpur in the Malwa region.
 
• By this treaty, Holkar gave the Southern portion of Satpura hills to Britishers.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The treaty of Gwalior was signed during the Third Anglo-Maratha War (1817-1818).

 
 
• This treaty was signed between Lord Warren Hasting and Daulat Rao Sindhia on 5th November 1817.
 
• Reason: 
 
 
• Malwa was under the control of Pindaris during 1817-1818.
 
• Pindaris started capturing British territories in India.
 
 
 
• So, this treaty was signed to make Pindaris ineffective.
 
• Clauses of this treaty:
 
 
• Both the parties i.e. Sindhia's and Britishers would deploy their armies in operation against Pindaris.
 
• Sindhia would never lend any support to Pindaris.
 
• Sindhia would deploy 5000 horsemen against Pindaris in the war 
 
 
 
 

 
• Third-Anglo Martha War -

 
 
• The Third- Anglo Maratha War was started during 1817-1818.
 
• Between: Britishers (Lord Hasting) and Baji Rao II, Malhar Rao Holkar, Appa Sahib, and Mudhoji Bhonsle.
 
• Reason: The Britishers suspected that Pindaris were being protected by the Marathas.
 
• Result:
 
 
• Treaty of Mandsaur and Treaty of Gwalior was signed.
 
• Peshwa surrendered and pensioned off to a small estate in Bithur, Kanpur.
 
• The areas annexed from the Pindaris became the Central Provinces of the Britishers.
 
• Led to the end of the Maratha Empire.

questions.question: 'Kamsale' is a dance form traditional to the states of_____.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Kamsale of Karnataka, also known as Beesu Kamsale is a vigorous dance form of the Kannad-speaking inhabitants of the state that employs a great blend of aesthetic sublimity and martial dexterity.
 
• Karnataka's Kamsale is mainly practised in the districts of Mysore, Nanjagud, Kollegal and Bangalore.
 
• The religious aspect of Kamsale is prominent.
 
• It narrates the glory of Lord Mahadeswara Shiva and the performers are vowed a lifelong allegiance to the god.
 
• The art is transmitted orally and through closely guarded traditions transmitted from the preceptor to the pupil.
 
• ​Kamsale derives its name from the musical instrument used in the performance.
 
• Usually, Kamsale is performed by a group of three to five dancers, although the number can go up to twelve with singers included.
 
• They wear traditional dresses in gold and red.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other Folk Dances of Karnataka are:-

 
 
• Krishna Parijatha,
 
• Bhootha Aradhane,
 
• Nagamandala,
 
• Karaga,
 
• Gaarudi Gombe,
 
• Joodu Haligi,
 
• Kamsale Nritya.

questions.question: What is the network of air tubes for gas exchange in insects?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Tracheae**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the respiratory system of insects **oxygen and carbon dioxide gases ****are exchanged through a network of tubes called tracheae**.
 
• Air enters and exits the respiratory systems of insects through a series of external openings called **spiracles.**
 
• **Spiracles' **external openings, which act as muscular valves in some insects, lead to the internal respiratory system, a densely networked array of tubes known as tracheae.
 
• **Air entered through the spiracles into the tracheal tubes and diffuses into the body tissues**.​__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​**Gills **are a **type of respiratory organ found in many aquatic animals**, including a number of worms, nearly all molluscs and crustaceans, some insect larvae, all fishes, and a few amphibians.
 
• The **diaphragm **is a thin, **dome-shaped muscle that sits below the lungs and heart muscle that helps to inhale and exhale (breathe in and out).**

questions.question: 'Rikhampada' is a traditional dance of _____.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rikhampada **is a traditional dance of the **Nishi tribe **of the lower Subansiri district of** Arunachal Pradesh**.
 
• It is believed that this dance and the **Nyokum festival **were introduced by one of their forefathers named Apatani when he along with his tribe migrated to the present place of settlement.
 
• The dance is accompanied by songs in the form of ballads narrating legends of love.
 
• It is performed by women only to express their love for their husbands and to offer their reverence to the gods.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question: Bhavartha Dipika and Amritanubhava are the sacred books of the people of ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhavartha Dipika and Amritanubhava **are the sacred books of the people of Maharasthra written by **Saint Dyaneshwar of Maharashtra**. 
 
• **Bhavartha Dipika **is the commentary book on **Bhagavad Geeta written in the Marathi language**.
 
• It is considered the **oldest surviving literary work of Marathi Literature**.__
 
• **Amritanubhav **is composed by the **poet Sant Dnyaneshwar during the 13th century.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Sant Dnyaneshwar, also referred to as Jnaneshwar **was born in 1275 in Maharashtra.**
 
• He was an **Indian Marathi saint, poet, philosopher, and yogi of the Nath Shaiva and Varkari tradition.**
 
• He authored many books in his short life **span of 21 years**.

questions.question: Which layer of atmosphere can experience burning up of meteorites?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mesosphere.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Earth's atmosphere is like a blanket of air and consists of different gases like **Nitrogen-78 %, Oxygen-21 %, Argon-0.93 %, and Carbon dioxide-0.04 %.**
 
• ​Earth's atmosphere is composed of six layers and the mesosphere is one such layer-
 
• Mesosphere: 
 
 
• This layer lies above the stratosphere and below the thermosphere and extends from 50 to 80 km above the earth's surface.
 
• It is the middle layer of the atmosphere. Because of the thin air, you would not breathe easily in this layer. 
 
• Most of the meteors and rock are burned up in these layers before reaching the earth. 
 
• This layer has more gases than the above layers i.e. exosphere and thermosphere which causes more friction and heat to burn up meteors.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

**Other layers are as follows: **

 
• Troposphere: The troposphere is the innermost layer of the earth's atmosphere.

 
 
• Mixing up of gases and changing weather occurs in this layer.
 
• This layer is dense and closest to the earth's surface and 10 - 15 km above the surface.
 
• This layer consists of dense air, water vapour, the formation of clouds, and all-weather phenomena that take place in this layer. 
 
• Thus, this layer contains about 80% of the total mass of the atmosphere.
 
 
 
• Stratosphere: This layer lies above the troposphere and below the mesosphere.
 
 
• The Earth's ozone layer is found in this layer.
 
• This ozone layer is located between 15 to 50 km above the surface.
 
• This layer absorbs the ultraviolet rays from the sun and gives protection to the earth from its harmful effects.
 
 
 
• Ionosphere: The Ionosphere is a highly active layer of the atmosphere as it shrinks or expands continuously depending upon the amount of energy absorbed.
 
 
• The sun radiation causes gases to form ions having an electric charge.
 
• This layer helps in propagating radio signals and sending them back to earth.
 
 
 
• Thermosphere: The thermosphere is located in between the exosphere and mesosphere.
 
 
• 'Thermos' means heat, this layer contains the most heat and this layer can produce heat up to 4,500 degrees Fahrenheit.
 
• This layer is the most thicker than all the inner layers of the atmosphere. 
 
 Exosphere: This is the outermost and thinner layer of the earth's atmosphere.

 
 
• It has a low atmospheric pressure and gas molecules are in wide spaces.
 
• It is composed of lighter gases like helium, argon, and hydrogen.

questions.question: What is the amount of unit assistance provided under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Gramin in hilly states?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**₹1.30 lakh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Under** Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Gramin** **₹1.30 lakh is allocated in hilly states/difficult areas /Integrated Action Plan (IAP) for Selected Tribal and Backward Districts.**
 
• For plain areas unit assistance of **Rs 120000 is given**.
 
• The Northeast States, States of HP, J&K, and Uttarakhand are identified as difficult and hilly areas. 
 
• The beneficiary would be facilitated to avail** loan of up to Rs.70,000/- for the construction of the house which is optional.**
 
• The beneficiary is **entitled to 90 days of unskilled labour from MGNREGA**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Funds will be transferred electronically directly to the account of the beneficiary.
 
• The rural housing scheme **Indira Awas Yojana has been revamped to Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana – Gramin **and approved in March 2016.
 
• Its objective is to **provide pucca houses to all who are houseless and living in dilapidated houses in rural areas by 2022**.
 
• Under the scheme, **financial assistance is provided for the construction of pucca houses for all houseless and households living in dilapidated houses.**
 
• **The scheme would be implemented in rural areas throughout India except for Delhi and Chandigarh**
